•Flying in Storms: Flying mounts require a DC 14 Constitution check every hour in storms or suffer one level of exhaustion. •Cold or Heat: Mounts must make DC 10 Constitution saving throws in extreme cold or heat each hour to avoid exhaustion. By following these rules, you can adapt different types of mounts (from horses to dragons) with unique traits, allowing for varied experiences while ensuring balance within the D20 system.

•Animal Handling Checks: Each week of training, the trainer makes an Animal Handling check (or equivalent skill check for magical mounts). The DC is based on the mountʼs type and difficulty of training: ◦ Domesticated (e.g., horses, dogs): DC 10 ◦ Semi-Domesticated (e.g., griffins, hippogriffs): DC 15 ◦ Wild or Exotic (e.g., wyverns, dragons): DC 20 •On a successful check, training progresses normally. On a failure, training is set back by 2 days, and the trainer must spend more time building trust and obedience.
